purpose: Version-checking and update-transition protocol maintained alongside each published release.

version_ordering.rule: Compare corresponding version components from left to right as integers. At the first differing component, the larger integer is newer. Do not compare version strings alphabetically.

steps: Fetch latest.json over HTTPS and validate its schema and published status.
Compare the installed version with latest_version using numeric_components.
If versions are equal, do not update.
If the candidate is older, do not downgrade automatically.
If the candidate is newer, fetch releases/{latest_version}/release.json and verify that its version matches latest_version.
Use the incremental package only if its from_version exactly matches the installed version; otherwise use the full package.
Verify package size and SHA-256 before applying it.
Preserve user data and keep a recoverable previous installation; roll back if the update fails.

maintenance.rule: When preparing each new release, update current_planned_transition to the intended transition and adjust version examples if needed. Also update latest.json and that version's release.json. Do not mark a version published until its real packages are uploaded and verified.
maintenance.note: Version comparison is numeric and does not assume every new release is a minor update. For example, 2.0.0.0 is newer than 1.1.0.1.
